title: Implement Sliding Window Maximum in Go
description: Implement SlidingWindowMax(nums []int, k int) []int returning the maximum in each window of size k using a monotone deque in O(n).

task_spec.prompt:
Implement SlidingWindowMax using a monotone deque of indices:
- Return empty if nums is empty or k<=0
- Maintain deque where front is always the index of the window's max
- For each index i: (1) remove front if it is outside window (< i-k+1); (2) remove from back while nums[back] < nums[i]; (3) append i to deque; (4) if i>=k-1, append nums[deque[0]] to result
- Return result
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
